title: Tennessee Code Section 4-21-408 - Leave for adoption, pregnancy, childbirth, and infant nursing

notes: The Tennessee Maternity Leave Act - the only general private-sector leave entitlement in the Tennessee Code, giving eligible employees up to four months of leave for adoption, pregnancy, childbirth and nursing, with reinstatement. Tennessee has no general annual-leave, sick-leave or holiday-pay statute for private employers; state-employee leave sits in Title 8, Chapter 50 (Miscellaneous Provisions), and legal holidays are designated by Title 15 (Holidays and Days of Special Observance), both verified present and unmarked in the register's table of contents. General family and medical leave is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 28). See the in_force caveat under Payroll/wages.
